entities.summary: Drayson Jack Bowman is an American former professional ice hockey player. A center, he previously played for the Montreal Canadiens and Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL). Bowman was selected 72nd overall by the Hurricanes in the 2007 NHL Entry Draft.
